This is a bugfix :adhesive_bandage: patch on top of the current stable release:
* Remove one cell gap around outposts
* Fixed support powers charging before the building appeared #1341
* Fixed support powers not pausing on low power
* Fixed :computer_mouse: cursor being hard to see on water #1349
* Fixed passengers dying when unloading from air transport #1353
* Fixed a crash when force moving air transports #1354
* Fixed size of the news panel for shorter messages

## Fixes
* Added more subtle fade-out animations for landed drop pods #1300
* Added :infinity: infinite unit queueing in the production palette #1304
* Added a longer chassis for the main battle tank in #1326
* Fixed a crash when a new user joins IRC #1301
* Fixed a crash when leaving Skirmish #1302
* Fixed :hash: IRC disconnecting when leaving the lobby
* Fixed Z sorting for map decorations :cactus: #1319 
* Fixed Z sorting for aircraft on trade platform #1320
* Fixed :newspaper: news panel being too small for changelog
* Fixed missing bridge shadows in Disruptive Innovation #1324
* Fixed mobile AA perspective #1323
* Fixed a shadow offset for Yuruki barracks #1328

## Balance
* Air super units death explosions deal more damage #1305
* Reduce pods speed in :evergreen_tree: forests #1306
* Don't allow mining towers to transform back due to #1207, #1298
* Increased Railgun Strike charge interval and time to hit #1307

## Campaign
* Added resource tower counters in Fillum missions #1281
* Added mining towers in Harbor Defense to reactivate ore smelters #1285
* Remove the enemy mining outpost in Ice River #1275 
* Remove special pods for players in Ice River #1275
* Send the colonists to attack when all buildings are destroyed in Itrium #1270
* Fixed faction colors in Asteroid Invasion being too dark #1246
* Fixed turrets destroying the harbors with friendly fire #1286
* Fixed enemy units in Crater Defense only using one entry point
* Fixed patrols not shooting at intruders in Scientist Rescue #1277
* Fixed blocked actors staying at entry point in Crater Defense #1282
* Fixed actors in large crowds not moving to target in Harbor Defense #1284

Based on a [development snapshot](https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA/wiki/Changelog-(bleed)/300a0c581716c1a122d9726e8759634934aa5e46) of @OpenRA

* Fixed start cash :dollar: in fire watch :fire_engine: mission.
* Fixed rendering glitches with mothership.
* Fixed not all unit production buildings allowing power down.
* Fixed not all helicopters being able to automatically target other aircraft.
* Fixed miners not deploying when blocked by actors.
* Fixed scrap blocking miners from deploying at resource nodes.
* Fixed capturing base building unlocking the whole tech tree.
* Fixed teleport network not disabling when powered down.
* Fixed empty storage indicator and replaced it with estimated income.
* Fixed the build menu not appearing when main base is lost and builder not selected.
* Fixed broken sand/grass/snow to tech tile transitions.
* Fixed tankers entering enemy resource towers.
* Added the `3 x 3 = 9` map remake.
* Added new 8 player map `Rain in the Fight`.
* Added new map `Diminishing Results` replacing `Diminishing Returns`.
* Added new map Meiotic Division. 
* Added more street lamps. :bulb: 
* Added chat history support.
* Added a no build zone :construction: around all resource extractors to prevent blocking. 
* Added shadows to intelligent land mines.
* Added shadows to gold balls that miners drop when destroyed.
* Added shadow to scrap that vehicles drop when destroyed.
* Added shadows to resource icons.
* Added Yuruki ore purifier to match Synapol ore smelter.
* Added new orbital railgun strike artwork and effects.
* Added shadows below high bridges.
* Balancing changes:
  * Capturable resource extractors generate less funds. :chart_with_downwards_trend: 
  * Televators now only require radars instead of tech centers.
  * Both factions now have ore refiners. Increased cost a bit.
  * Broker pod is no longer trainable. :bank: 
  * Rocket pod moved to Synapol and increased firing rate.
  * Mortar pod moved to Synapol and reduced cost slightly.
  * Sniper and flame pod can't detect cloaked units anymore.
  * Mortar and flame pod no longer explode violently when killed.
  * Technician can detect cloaked units and repair pods.
  * Synapol elite pod is now available to all factions and increased cost.
  * Bomber pod moved from Synapol to Yuruki.
  * Electric pod now mirrors the rocket pod for Yuruki.
  * Rebalanced Howitzer and Shield.
  * Increased line of sight for walls and gates.
  * Changed weapons for aircraft.
  * Removed auto targeting for transport airplanes and widened attack range.
  * Swapped bike and buggy factions and buffed stats.
  * Swapped countermeasure and hacker tank.
  * Increased costs for stealth tanks.
  * Removed attacking from inside transport tank.
  * Rebalanced missile tank and stealth tank.
  * Changed Yuruki assault tank projectile sprite.
  * Increased damage to bomber pod against fortification.
  * Rebalanced ships and increased their line of sights.
  * Increased costs for advanced and artillery boats.
  * Allow recon tank to detect underwater units as well.
  * Increased natural resource deposits.
  * Traders can now order builders and bike/buggy.
  * Aircraft repair on trade platform is possible now.
  * Disabled gates/walls on bot matches. :robot:
